title: Evaluation preserved by strictification
statement: Let $C$ be a family of Boolean circuits such that every circuit in the family is well formed and every gate has at most two arguments. For every input length $n$ and every Boolean input of length $n$, the circuit produced by strictifying $C_n$ has the same output as $C_n$.
hypotheses_covered: Every circuit in the family is well formed and each of its gates has at most two arguments.
